reviews.comment: Overall I just don't recommend this course if you don't have to take it. I haven't heard good things about any MSEN222 profs. Took the class online so basically self taught. Not a lot of work, just watch lectures and homework every week. Homeworks and exams are difficult. Complex questions on exams and are not given practice problems in 'lectures'.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor didn't teach anything. I saw him a total of 3 time through the semester, 1 time in the introductory lecture video, and then each of the remaining times in the review videos for the exams. This is pretty much a self-study/recitation learning class. Try to take in person with a good professor, take online only if you like textbooks.

Take it online. Very responsive, nice and caring person, but that is it. Review for exam is not helpful at all. Exam is Canvas based. No step credits. And you have to really understand the material to get better grade, which is not a good option for non-Material Science major students. There is extra credit opportunity but a lot of requirement.
